C0226.title: US Government Websites Hit by SEO Poisoning Attack
C0226.summary: In December 2025, a large-scale SEO poisoning attack targeted .gov domains across multiple US states and local governments. Attackers exploited public file upload functions on government websites to upload PDF files containing malicious links.
